doc: A schema-6 work.db from the shaped fixture (its $HOME made the root's home): the hub moves it to schema 7 before it serves, so when the first ping answers the file is schema 7 with schema 6's rows behind the compat views (the deny-list's rows under ~/org left out), the decisions entities, and status says when it moved.

sql: update node set id = replace(id, '$' || 'HOME', '$HOME'), path = replace(path, '$' || 'HOME', '$HOME'), parent = replace(parent, '$' || 'HOME', '$HOME'), source = replace(source, '$' || 'HOME', '$HOME'), data = replace(data, '$' || 'HOME', '$HOME')
update edge set src = replace(src, '$' || 'HOME', '$HOME'), dst = replace(dst, '$' || 'HOME', '$HOME'), source = replace(source, '$' || 'HOME', '$HOME')
update job set plan = replace(plan, '$' || 'HOME', '$HOME'), repo = replace(repo, '$' || 'HOME', '$HOME')

update agent set cwd = replace(cwd, '$' || 'HOME', '$HOME'), worktree = replace(worktree, '$' || 'HOME', '$HOME'), plan = replace(plan, '$' || 'HOME', '$HOME'), task = replace(task, '$' || 'HOME', '$HOME')
select value from kv where key = 'schema'
select count(*) from entity where kind = 'decision'
select count(*) from entity where title like '%CANARY%'
select json_extract(value, '$.tables.node') from kv where key = 'migrate-7'
